how: The live suite's smoke case, then pdf-brief and board-pack, each run twice, against llama.cpp b11050 on an RTX 3080 held to an 8 GB card's budget (--fit-target, 7,206 MiB free less the app's 1 GiB margin), with the app's preset: a 32,768-token window and four slots. A case passes only when both of its runs passed. The decision it backs is docs/adr/0094-the-star-goes-to-a-model-that-runs-the-agent.md.

notes: Q8_0: smoke 2 of 2, pdf-brief 2 of 2, board-pack 2 of 2; first token 2.2 s after loading, 104 tok/s.
Q4_K_M on a 6 GB card's budget (5,234 MiB free): smoke 2 of 2, pdf-brief 1 of 2, board-pack 0 of 2.
